glosses: free time, leisure time, spare time. The time during which one is not working.

examples.text: Was machst du in deiner Freizeit?
examples.en: What do you do in your free time?

examples.text: Wir haben diese Woche viel Freizeit.
examples.en: We have a lot of free time this week.
You have too much time on your hands.

examples.text: Ich wünschte, ich hätte mehr Freizeit.
examples.en: I wish I had more free time.
